scope: Documentary key census for existing illustrated profiles. Main backlog: side-view-candidate, combatEnabled=true, no unresolved remaining-evidence entry. Other profiles remain separate.

definitions.missing: Exact valid clip key absent from art/registry.json; idle fallback never fills that key.
definitions.animated: At least two distinct pixelSHA256 values in the clip; metadata taken from the matching built manifest after exact registry clip/path/file-hash equality checks.
definitions.static: One distinct pixel image, including a clip that repeats that image over multiple steps.
definitions.enabledCommand: createCombatProfile(fighter).moves[key].enabled === true. Runtime meter, HP, grounded/air, guard and recovery windows remain conditional.
definitions.baseGates: All ten base contract keys are counted explicitly. A second count excludes missing walk/dodge disabled by policy, jump for a fixed grounded body, and phase with no later boss/weapon phase. This is not a live reachability proof.
definitions.presentation: Seven ordinary own contexts are enumerated separately from nine generic keys. Ordinary hooks run for combatants; taunt additionally requires an approved proposal. Current first-weapon playback is sampled without any actor-state mutation.
definitions.referenceHolds: vague26 remaining-evidence is retained as a production hold, including legacy art and historical refusals. An engine-enabled move does not override that hold.

referenceHolds.note: These hold/role flags overlap the mutually exclusive artwork groups and must not be added to them.

genericPresentations.meaning: Generic legal key coverage only; an exact subject context can replace the seven ordinary generic keys. Generic finisher/finished cannot fill an exact finisher context.

contextualFinishers.reason: A legal key is not proof of an enabled sequence. Attacker, target anatomy, exact recipe, stage props, phase and source permissions decide eligibility. No Cartesian product is counted as required artwork.

readmeText: Sur 204 profils illustrés, 165 ont une vue latérale candidate et le combat activé sans dossier restant ouvert. Pour ce périmètre : 3081 commandes activées n’ont pas de clip dédié (7 présentes sur 3088); 212 commandes désactivées sont exclues. 1292 clés d’états de base manquent hors désactivations/transitions non prévues (1444 absences sur le contrat brut de dix états). 1154 présentations ordinaires activées n’ont ni clip contextuel ni substitut générique utilisable. 1 idle d’arme exact manque. Ces catégories ne sont pas un nombre d’animations attendues; 6 clips animés sont actuellement enregistrés dans ce périmètre.
limits: No art generated, no file pixels edited, no global file written, and no source-fidelity certification performed.
Illustrated noncombatants and unresolved roles receive no actionable combat-animation debt.
No required frame count, original timing, opposite-side drawing or missing animation count is inferred from an idle.
Generic and contextual presentation deficits overlap and must not be added together.
Weapon phases and exhausted ammunition variants reuse command keys; their additional artwork/timing cannot be inferred by multiplying enabled slots.
Clip-entry counts are counts of keys, not distinct drawings. Different keys may refer to the same imported image; repeating one image never creates an animated clip.
Finisher attacker/victim/stage requirements are not exhaustively enumerated or promoted from valid key syntax to enabled choreography.
The documentary audit checks the registered clip contract and profile flags; it is not a browser or full per-input live combat test.
